title: I Was Minding My Own Business

vocabulary.meaning_en: an action that is against the law
vocabulary.example: Stealing is a crime.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where something happens
vocabulary.note_ar: the scene of a crime = مسرح الجريمة.
vocabulary.note_en: the scene of a crime = the place where a crime happened.
vocabulary.example: The police are at the scene.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short time to stop work and eat lunch
vocabulary.example: I go for a walk during my lunch break.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to cause pain to a body part
vocabulary.note_ar: الماضي والتصريف الثالث نفس الكلمة: hurt - hurt - hurt.
vocabulary.note_en: Past and past participle are the same: hurt - hurt - hurt.
vocabulary.example: I hurt my leg playing football.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the part of the body between the shoulder and the hand
vocabulary.example: She broke her arm last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay attention to your own life, not other people's
vocabulary.example: I was just minding my own business when the phone rang.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to shout loudly
vocabulary.example: Don't yell. I can hear you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who takes things from people, often using force
vocabulary.example: The robbers ran away with the money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take something quickly and roughly
vocabulary.example: He grabbed his bag and ran to the bus.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thing you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
vocabulary.example: Take an umbrella. It's raining.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to use your body to hurt or stop someone
vocabulary.example: The children should not fight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to leave a place quickly to escape
vocabulary.example: The cat ran away when it saw the dog.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to chase; to run to catch someone
vocabulary.example: I ran after the bus, but it didn't stop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feeling fear
vocabulary.example: My little brother is afraid of the dark.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to relax or sleep after activity
vocabulary.example: I rested on a bench in the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long seat for two or more people, often outside
vocabulary.example: We sat on a bench and ate our sandwiches.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hit your foot on something and almost fall
vocabulary.example: Be careful! Don't trip on the stairs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go down to the ground suddenly
vocabulary.example: The baby fell, but she is OK.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the surface of the earth
vocabulary.example: The book fell on the ground.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put your foot on something
vocabulary.example: Sorry, I stepped on your foot!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say you are sorry
vocabulary.example: He apologized for being late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone leave (informal)
vocabulary.note_en: get kicked off = be made to leave.
vocabulary.example: They got kicked off the bus because they didn't pay.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small amount of food between meals
vocabulary.example: I eat an apple as a snack.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with
vocabulary.example: My co-workers are very kind.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not able to move
vocabulary.example: My hand is stuck in the jar!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that sells drinks or snacks when you put in money
vocabulary.example: I bought water from the vending machine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: thin, dry, fried slices of potato sold in a bag (US)
vocabulary.note_ar: بالبريطانية: crisps. أما chips بالبريطانية فهي البطاطس المقلية.
vocabulary.note_en: UK: crisps. In the UK, "chips" are French fries.
vocabulary.example: Do you want a bag of chips?

fine_lines.title: was/were + -ing vs past simple
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الماضي المستمر (was running) لحدث طويل كان مستمراً، والماضي البسيط (fell) لحدث قصير قطعه. while تأتي غالباً مع الحدث الطويل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Past continuous (was running) is for a longer action in progress; past simple (fell) is for a short action that happened in the middle of it. While usually goes with the longer action.

examples.sentence: While I was running, I tripped and fell.
Someone stepped on my arm while I was lying on the ground.

fine_lines.title: run away vs run after
fine_lines.explanation_ar: run away = يهرب من مكان أو شخص. run after = يركض خلف شخص ليمسكه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Run away = leave quickly to escape. Run after = chase someone to catch them.

fine_lines.title: hurt yourself / hurt your arm
fine_lines.explanation_ar: عندما نتحدث عن إصابة، يحتاج hurt إلى مفعول به: إما ضمير منعكس (I hurt myself) أو جزء من الجسم (I hurt my arm). أما إذا كان جزء الجسم هو الفاعل فلا يحتاج مفعولاً: My arm hurts = ذراعي تؤلمني.
fine_lines.explanation_en: When you talk about an injury, hurt needs an object: a reflexive pronoun (I hurt myself) or a body part (I hurt my arm). When the body part is the subject, no object is needed: My arm hurts (= it is painful).

examples.sentence: I hurt myself in the kitchen.
I hurt my arm in a vending machine.

expressions.phrase: I was minding my own business.
expressions.meaning_ar: كنت في حالي (لا أتدخل في شيء).
expressions.meaning_en: I was not doing anything to cause the problem.
expressions.example: I was minding my own business when a ball hit my window.
You have a bandage. What happened to your arm?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking someone to continue a story.
expressions.example: You lost your bag? So, what happened next?

expressions.phrase: I had no time to be afraid.
expressions.meaning_en: Things happened too fast to feel fear.
expressions.example: It all happened so fast. I had no time to be afraid.

expressions.meaning_en: Used to show you are sorry about someone's bad news.
expressions.example: You missed the bus? That's too bad.
My friend is hurt. Please come right away.

expressions.meaning_en: I am phoning someone to come and help.
expressions.example: Don't move. I'm calling for help right now.

expressions.phrase: You've got to pay when you get on a bus.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن تدفع عندما تركب الحافلة.
expressions.meaning_en: You must pay (informal: have got to = have to).
expressions.example: You've got to show your ticket when you get on the train.

grammar.title: Past continuous: was/were + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر لنصف حدثاً كان مستمراً في وقت معين في الماضي. التكوين: I/he/she/it + was + فعل ing، و you/we/they + were + فعل ing. النفي: was not / were not. السؤال: Were you afraid? / What were you doing?
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past continuous for an action that was in progress at a time in the past. Form: I/he/she/it + was + verb-ing; you/we/they + were + verb-ing. Negative: was not / were not. Question: Were you running? What were you doing?
examples: Two robbers were grabbing her bag.
At that time, I was not fighting the robbers.

grammar.title: while + past continuous, past simple
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم while مع الحدث الطويل (الماضي المستمر)، والحدث القصير المفاجئ يكون بالماضي البسيط. يمكن أن تأتي while في بداية الجملة (مع فاصلة) أو في وسطها.
grammar.explanation_en: Use while with the long action (past continuous). The short, sudden action is in the past simple. While can start the sentence (use a comma) or come in the middle.
examples: While I was running, I tripped and fell.
While I was lying on the ground, someone stepped on my arm.
She hurt herself while she was trying to stop the crime.

grammar.title: Reflexive pronouns: myself, yourself, herself ...
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم الضمير المنعكس عندما يكون الفاعل والمفعول به نفس الشخص. myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
grammar.explanation_en: Use a reflexive pronoun when the subject and the object are the same person: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
examples: It looks like she hurt herself.
The robbers got themselves kicked off the bus.
We have to find ourselves another story.

questions.question: Complete: "Two robbers ____ her bag."
questions.explanation_en: Robbers is plural, so use were + -ing.

questions.question: Complete: "While I ____, I tripped and fell."
questions.explanation_ar: مع I نستخدم was + ing للحدث الطويل.
questions.explanation_en: With I, use was + -ing for the longer action.

questions.question: Choose the correct reflexive pronoun: "She hurt ____."
The robbers took the bag and left quickly. They ...
questions.explanation_en: Run away = leave quickly to escape.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
choices: I was rest on a bench.
I were resting on a bench.
I was resting on a bench.

questions.question: "I was minding my own business" means ...
choices: I was working in my own company.
I was not doing anything to other people.
questions.explanation_ar: mind my own business = كنت في حالي ولا أتدخل في شيء.
questions.explanation_en: It means I was not doing anything to cause trouble.

questions.question: A machine that sells snacks and drinks is a ...
questions.explanation_ar: vending machine آلة تبيع الوجبات الخفيفة والمشروبات.
questions.explanation_en: A vending machine sells snacks and drinks.

questions.question: Someone stepped on Anna's arm, but they didn't say sorry. They didn't ...
Complete the question: "What ____ you doing at noon?"
questions.explanation_ar: مع you نستخدم were في الماضي المستمر.
questions.explanation_en: With you, use were in the past continuous.
